pins.description:
Rubble Pile Peek (SL4) - Not Common
You can climb the rubble pile out of the bottom side spawn and peek over the entirety of the park and other parts of the map. You can use most tanks to get up, although you may need to climb side to side.
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com

pins.description:
Out of map flank (SL5.1) - Somewhat common
From the top spawn, you can rush across and climb this rubble pile to exit the map boundaries. Then follow straight and slight left into the pin below this.
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com

pins.description:
Out of map flank (SL5.2) - Somewhat common
This is where you re-enter the map boundaries. You will need to be quick about this. The enemies might hear you or see you, and you may get stuck on the pile. If pulled off successfully, you get 2-3 free kills unless the enemy is very blind.
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com

pins.description:
Rubble Peek (SL6) - Uncommon, yet easy to see
This spot relies on you being able to kill the enemy before they realize you are up there. You need a runup and this spot is reliable for about 1:30 before the enemy you first killed pushed back and peeks you.
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com

pins.description:
Rubble Peek Through Building (SL7) - Never seen
This peek requires you to drive up this rubble pile quickly and reach the top. Starting from the monument side is almost necessary. This allows you to peek onto the a cap and parts of the park. However, you are exposed behind you.
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com

pins.description:
Rubble peek addition (SL7.1) - Never seen
This is an addition to the other peek on this pile. You can back up a bit towards the monument and peek into almost every way to get out of the top side spawn. This is a risky peek but can pay off if you are quick and hit your shots.
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com

pins.description:
Shoot through Building (SL8) - Uncommon
You are able to shoot through the doors and windows of the brick building. This is useful against somebody sitting on the a cap. They might try to shoot you so try to get your shot off quick
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com

pins.description:
Rubble Peek to monument (SL9) - Never Seen
You can climb the rubble pile to get a view through the window onto the east side of the monument. This is a special use case when somebody is camping or when you would like to camp.
pins.author: hotbowl1080@gmail.com
